      <p>Procurement sits on some of the richest data in any company: every supplier, every contract, every dollar that leaves the building.       <p>That gap matters more than ever. Supply-chain volatility, cost pressure, and AI are changing how quickly organizations need to see risk and act on opportunity. I went back to school to build the technical foundation (SQL, Spark, cloud platforms, and data visualization) so I can lead that shift rather than wait for it.</p>
